question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The Priest said, “God loves all his creations.”

options.text: The Priest said that God is about to love all his creations.
The Priest said that God will love all his creations.
The Priest said that God loves all his creations.
The Priest said that God loved all his creations.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The Priest said that God loves all his creations."**
